articles.title: MTSI Q3 CY2026 deep dive: robust growth met by market skepticism amid supply chain and end-market shifts
articles.summary: Network chips maker MACOM Technology Solutions (NASDAQ: MTSI) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026) results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 62.7% year on year to $424.8 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($455 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 5.4% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.09 per share was 4.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
